reason: I don't work with creators at all; my regulars, Google reviews and the WhatsApp group already fill my slots. This only does anything once a creator sends me a link, and the ones who message me just want free stuff.
objection: It's a tool for measuring something I don't do. Why would I start paying creators just so I can count them?
would_change_my_mind: Another salon or gym owner I know nearby showing me real numbers, like creators bringing in paying customers who came back, at a cost per customer below what a Google review push or a WhatsApp offer costs me.
